يبتدهون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَدِهُونَ (yabtadihūna) /jab.ta.di.huː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# يُبْتَدَهُونَ (yubtadahūna) /jub.ta.da.huː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
